items.text: Survey host signup/application pages, earnings page and public settings API (schema, migration, env config, referral and nudge services all existed; the fee endpoint did not)
Build the fee comparison calculator on the become-a-host page (new public /api/public/fees, one page serving both calculator URLs)
Add founding-host perk: enrolment was never called at approval, so no host could ever be enrolled; now wired and proven against a throwaway database
Verify the referral reward end to end (code issued at approval, applied at signup, credited once on the referred host's first released payout)
Verify the abandoned-application nudges (sweep scheduled at boot, capped, push only)
Verify with lint, build, type-check and server tests, then commit and push (f6bb3b6)
Your side: run npx prisma migrate deploy on Railway, then set HOST_COMMISSION_RATE and the other money settings
